_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::input_format#24. A 1-element HEX8 deck declares DSURFACE 1 and 2 in DSURF-NODE TOPOLOGY. With the Dirichlet on E: 1 it exits 0; with the Dirichlet on E: 5 it exits 1 before solving anything (BAD_RAN_A_RESULT_TEST=0), so an empty entity is never silently dropped. The message is off by one from what was written: the deck says E: 5 and 4C says 'DSurface 4 not in range [0:2[' followed by 'DSurface condition on non existent DSurface?Could not read set from entity type.' from core/fem/src/condition/4C_fem_condition.cpp line 133 — the internal id is 0-based and the range is half-open, and the id the author typed is never echoed (BAD_ECHOES_THE_WRITTEN_ID=0). Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf) at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
